{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
LOG="/root/poll_eval_vanilla_object_s1.log"
TRAIN_PID=798980
CHKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/vanilla_object_s1"

echo "$(date -u): Polling started for vanilla_object_s1" >> $LOG

while true; do
    CHKPT_DIR=$(ls -d ${CHKPT_BASE}/*50000_chkpt 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$CHKPT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$CHKPT_DIR/adapter_config.json" ]; then
        echo "$(date -u): 50000_chkpt detected at $CHKPT_DIR! Waiting 60s for save to finish..." >> $LOG
        sleep 60
        if ps -p $TRAIN_PID -o pid= 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "$(date -u): Training still running, waiting for natural exit..." >> $LOG
            for i in $(seq 1 10); do
                sleep 60
                if ! ps -p $TRAIN_PID -o pid= 2>/dev/null; then
                    echo "$(date -u): Training process exited naturally" >> $LOG
                    break
                fi
            done
            if ps -p $TRAIN_PID -o pid= 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "$(date -u): Killing training PID $TRAIN_PID" >> $LOG
                kill $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null
                sleep 5
                kill -9 $TRAIN_PID 2>/dev/null
            fi
        fi
        echo "$(date -u): Starting eval on cuda:0..." >> $LOG
        source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate occsafe
        cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft
        CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 MUJOCO_GL=egl MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=0 python3 vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py \
            --pretrained_checkpoint "$CHKPT_DIR" \
            --task_suite_name libero_object \
            --num_rollouts 50 \
            --seed 42 >> $LOG 2>&1
        echo "$(date -u): Eval completed with exit code $?" >> $LOG
        break
    fi
    sleep 60
done
